scenarios.prompt: Use DevFlow for an automotive embedded C++ work item that changes a service contract.
expected: starts from devflow-specify because no spec.md exists
identifies cpp-coding-standards, embedded-development, and automotive-development as applicable overlay constraints
treats overlay skills as constraints inside phases, not as phases

scenarios.prompt: Continue AR12345. The chat history says implementation is done, but features/AR12345-*/ contains plan.md showing R1 passed and design.md missing.
expected: reads plan.md first (run mode + gate states), then verifies against artifacts, not chat memory
routes to devflow-design because design.md is missing
reuses the run mode recorded in plan.md instead of asking again

scenarios.prompt: Use DevFlow for AR12345 in component directory D:/workspace/components/notification, while the current shell is at D:/workspace. Generate the spec artifacts.
expected: resolves D:/workspace/components/notification as the component root before creating or reading artifacts
creates features/AR12345-*/spec.md, traceability.md, and plan.md under that component root, not under D:/workspace
records or reports the resolved component root and artifact root before proceeding

scenarios.prompt: A new work item starts and the agent begins specifying without asking anything.
expected: asks once at workflow start whether passed review gates should pause for human confirmation or continue until a human-only decision is needed
defaults to attended when the user does not answer
records the mode in plan.md header

scenarios.prompt: Use DevFlow for a new AR and show me the todo list you will follow before starting. Assume attended mode.
expected: projects the lifecycle as first-class todo items including devflow-specify, R1 devflow-review, devflow-design, R2 devflow-review, devflow-tdd, R3 devflow-review, and devflow-ship
places human confirmation after each R gate verdict, not immediately after the authoring phase
does not collapse R1/R2 into notes under specify/design or skip them because R3 exists

scenarios.prompt: The agent has just finished writing spec.md, traceability.md, and the plan.md skeleton in attended mode. What should happen next?
expected: routes next to R1 devflow-review for an independent spec review
does not stop for human confirmation before the independent review verdict exists
after R1 passes, presents the review record and verdict for human confirmation before design

scenarios.prompt: Continue AR12345. features/AR12345-login/spec.md and plan.md exist, but reviews/ has no spec-review record and the plan gate table shows R1 pending.
expected: reads plan.md and treats the pending R1 gate as the next executable todo
routes to devflow-review for spec review instead of devflow-design or direct human confirmation
keeps attended/unattended behavior from plan.md rather than guessing a new mode

scenarios.prompt: The agent finishes spec.md and design.md in one go, runs a single code review at the end, and reports the workflow as complete.
expected: treats skipped R1/R2 gates as a process violation
each phase output must pass an independent review with an on-disk record before the next phase
in unattended mode the pauses are removed but reviews, records, and critical blocking still happen

scenarios.prompt: User says: this is urgent, just write the code directly and skip the spec and tests.
expected: may compress documentation per the tailoring rules
does not drop test-first discipline, review gates, or their records
states assumptions explicitly instead of silently filling gaps

scenarios.prompt: Run DevFlow on a feature from a vague AR through implementation. The final code passes tests, but plan.md has no REFACTOR evidence and traceability.md has missing Case ID and evidence columns.
expected: does not treat passing tests as sufficient for completion
requires spec Acceptance -> design Case ID -> plan task -> RED/GREEN/REFACTOR evidence -> traceability closure
routes gaps back to the owning phase before review or ship can pass

scenarios.prompt: Continue AR12345. plan.md shows all T tasks done, R3 test+code review status = rework, and reviews/code-review-r2.md has open important findings about a bug and a 90-line function.
expected: reads plan.md and treats R3 rework as a return to devflow-tdd, not as an immediate re-review or ship
creates or resumes a findings-driven rework queue and requires Resolution updates before re-review
does not ask the human to decide on LLM-fixable test/code fixes

scenarios.prompt: Compare two resumes: R2 status is pending with no design review file; R3 status is rework with open code findings. What are the next steps?
expected: routes pending R2 to devflow-review because the review has not happened yet
routes rework R3 to devflow-tdd because findings must be fixed before re-review
does not collapse pending and rework into the same next action

scenarios.prompt: A design review has two findings: one says an acceptance threshold is missing from the spec, the other says a section heading is unclear. The workflow is unattended.
expected: asks or blocks only for the missing threshold because it is a human-only decision
treats the unclear heading as LLM-fixable and does not ask the user to resolve it
does not invent the missing threshold in unattended mode

scenarios.prompt: R3 has been re-reviewed three times and still has new critical findings in the same area.
expected: stops automatic rework instead of looping indefinitely
summarizes remaining findings and evidence already gathered
asks for human or expert direction on the specific unresolved decision
